evals.name: palette-from-project
evals.prompt: /record-demo root/project: open the palette with Ctrl K and type "font"
evals.expected_output: An MP4 in target/demos that opens on the project mock, shows the palette opening and the query being typed, and a contact sheet the agent read before replying. The agent's own server is stopped at the end.
assertions: The agent checks for trunk, ffmpeg and ffprobe and loads the recording tools before it opens a preview tab
The agent starts its own trunk serve with --port on a free port, not 8765
The preview tab opens that port with the path /?mock=root/project
The agent runs keep-painting.js in the tab before it starts recording
The agent pauses with preview_evaluate and a setTimeout promise, never a foreground sleep
The video is saved under target/demos with a name that starts with root-project
The agent runs contact-sheet.sh, reads the sheet, and describes its first and last frames
The agent closes the tab it opened and stops the server it started

evals.name: unknown-mock
evals.expected_output: The snapshot's console shows the panic for the unknown mock, and the agent tells the user without recording.
assertions: The final message says no mock is called root/nope
The agent closes the tab it opened and stops the server it started

evals.name: no-flow
evals.expected_output: The agent asks what flow to record and records nothing.
assertions: The final message asks for the flow
The agent never starts a server or opens a preview tab
